decisive_items: bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses
sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells
did not improve on intravenous ceftriaxone
response.rationale: Systemic masses, atypical mononuclear infiltrate, and antibiotic failure favor a systemic lymphoproliferative disorder; CTCL is a subset but lacks specific cutaneous features and does not explain retroperitoneal/adrenal involvement.

rejected.why: Imaging myositis/edema is nonspecific and contradicted by lack of response to antibiotics and atypical cells on biopsy.
Systemic symptoms and infiltrate are nonspecific; no granulomas described, and atypical mononuclear cells are more consistent with neoplasia.
Histiocytic disorders are rare and not supported by the biopsy description or systemic pattern.
